evals.prompt: 我想做一個好感度系統，聊天的時候能看到數字。
evals.expected_output: Uses lunatalk-mod-author; designs a small card with a concrete, bounded rule for the affection field; states the draft can be playtested before publishing.
expectations: The output treats this as a MOD, not a role card or worldbook.
The affection field's rule names concrete triggers and bounded deltas, not a restatement of the label.
The output keeps the field count small rather than adding unrequested stats.
The output says the draft can be enabled and played before submitting.

evals.prompt: 幫我把這個 MOD 送審，我剛改完。
evals.expected_output: Asks whether it was actually played after the edit, and routes to validate plus a real playtest before submit.
expectations: The output does not submit immediately on request.
The output requires a real playtest of the draft, not only a schema check.
The output explains that publishing is what makes it visible to other people.

evals.prompt: 存檔失敗了，說 version conflict。我再存一次就好了吧？
evals.expected_output: Explains the MOD changed after it was read and that the fix is read-modify-write via mod_get, not a retry.
expectations: The output rejects retrying the same write.
The output routes to reading the current version back before saving.
The output does not suggest discarding the other change silently.

evals.prompt: 我想加十五個狀態欄位，越豐富越好。
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on field count, explains per-turn attention and prompt cost, and proposes a smaller set with sharper rules.
expectations: The output explains that every field competes for attention each turn.
The output connects long rules to prompt cost and memory compaction.
The output proposes fewer fields with stronger rules rather than accepting all fifteen.

evals.prompt: 這個欄位我想記錄「玩家上次登入到現在幾天」。
evals.expected_output: Points out the model cannot observe that from the conversation, and proposes state the model can actually derive.
expectations: The output identifies that the value has no source the model can read.
The output proposes an observable alternative instead of accepting the field.

evals.prompt: 什麼時候該用 params，什麼時候直接寫死？
evals.expected_output: Explains params are for values different players reasonably want different, and warns each one adds player-facing complexity.
expectations: The output ties params to genuine per-player variation.
The output warns that each param is one more thing the player must understand.
The output does not treat params as a way to avoid deciding.

evals.prompt: 我的卡片 HTML 被拒了，我把它拆成兩段再貼進去可以嗎？
evals.expected_output: Says the limit is a limit, points at the diagnostic naming which one, and refuses the workaround.
expectations: The output refuses to work around the limit by splitting or inlining markup.
The output routes to the validation diagnostic to see which limit was hit.

evals.prompt: 我要做一張新角色卡，個性設定要很完整。
evals.expected_output: Routes to role card authoring; this is not MOD work.
expectations: The output does not author a MOD.
The output routes role identity and voice to the card authoring skill.
